About Me

Code meets data —
results follow.

Hi! I'm Charan Tej Kanuguri, a Computer Science undergraduate at Lovely Professional University with a deep passion for building beautiful frontends and transforming raw data into meaningful insights.

As an AI&ML Intern at Infosys Springboard, I built a resume analysis system using NLP embeddings, cosine similarity, and LLM-based reasoning — combining everything I love about development and data science.

Whether it's crafting a pixel-perfect SPA in React, building a Power BI dashboard revealing crime patterns, or running EDA on 26K+ EV records — I solve problems that matter.
